segments.title: Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official broadcast sign-on and countdown, identifying as the dog who produces the show.

segments.title: Hype Train Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the feed with a high-tempo Dragon Ball Z-themed freestyle rap, reaching level 5 and declaring himself a 'balling girl' before signing off.

segments.title: Hulk Hogan on Logan Paul's Impulsive Podcast
segments.notes: Case and Tyler cover Hulk Hogan's appearance on Logan Paul's podcast, including Hogan comparing himself to Chris Benoit, describing RNC tech rehearsal, and claiming he never rehearses matches.

segments.title: Candyland RPG Pitch with Jelly Bean
segments.notes: A caller identifying as a jelly bean explains Candyland is a dice-rolling RPG with deep lore, promotes Sunday stream with sketch group Cigarette Sandwich plus John Madison, and reveals human goo is a personal candy preference.

segments.title: JD Vance Humanity Debate
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate whether JD Vance is human while wearing matching gold jackets; Crum argues Vance is a 'collection of talking points wedged into an incredibly unappealing box,' Munch claims victory via retie, and both acknowledge lizard-person control.

segments.title: AI Music Streaming Fraud: Michael Smith Indictment
segments.notes: Case and Tyler detail the FBI indictment of North Carolina musician Michael Smith for a $10M AI-generated music streaming bot scheme, attempt to locate tracks by 'Callus Post' and 'Calary Screams' on TikTok, and listen to generic AI output.

segments.title: Movie Trailer Watch: Minecraft, Frankie Freako, Mom and Dad Save the World
segments.notes: Case, Tyler, and Chris (parole officer) react to the live-action Minecraft movie trailer, the Freddy Freaker horror-comedy trailer, and a 1992 home video trailer for Mom and Dad Save the World featuring Jon Lovitz and Kathy Ireland.

segments.title: Tim Pool & Tenet Media Russian Influence Indictment
segments.notes: Case and Tyler cover the DOJ indictment alleging Russia Today paid Tenet Media $10M to distribute covert Russian messaging via conservative influencers Tim Pool, Dave Rubin, and Benny Johnson, who claim victimhood; Case and Tyler joke about seeking Russian funding.

segments.title: Kendall & Zed Google Playground Promo
segments.notes: Case plays a video of Kendelle with EDM artist Zed promoting a Google Play playground activation; chat is instructed to comment 'nice things' using the name Kendall.

segments.title: Chet's Hamilton Therapy Session
segments.notes: Chet and Dr. Chath (wearing sunglasses) conduct a therapy session that devolves into a Hamilton-parody rap about Chet's 'golden dong,' bench pressing 330 lbs, and jawline perfection; session costs $15,000.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Candyland RPG Reminder
segments.notes: Case thanks chat, promotes Sunday's Candyland RPG stream at 11 AM PT / 2 PM ET with Cigarette Sandwich and John Madison, raids Cycor.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the broadcast from the newsroom desk, wore a cheap gold jacket, covered Hulk Hogan, AI music fraud, Russian influence indictment, and movie trailers.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open sign-on, fixed camera zoom issues, accidentally activated a 'human face' button during therapy transition.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Hijacked the sub-goal celebration with a Dragon Ball Z freestyle rap, reached level 5, declared 'balling girl' status.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated Crum on JD Vance's humanity while wearing a gold jacket he ordered, claimed victory via retie, admitted lizard people control Vance.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued JD Vance is an inhuman 'collection of talking points,' accidentally ran an ad break instead of a poll, revealed full name 'Leonard Grumfuusius Grum.'

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Confirmed he ordered the gold jackets via Munch, admitted intercepting the first jacket delivery, briefly interacted on camera.

characters.name: Jelly Bean
characters.notes: call-in guest. Pitched the Candyland RPG as a dice-rolling lore-heavy game, promoted Sunday stream with sketch group, stated human goo is a personal candy preference.

characters.name: Tyler
characters.notes: co-host/correspondent. Co-hosted news segments with Case, discussed AI music fraud and Russian indictment, wore tight gold pants, left early citing personal obligations.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Appeared in therapy segment wearing 'therapy glasses,' performed a Hamilton-parody rap about his penis and bench press, claimed to be 'the old Chet.'

characters.name: Dr. Chath
characters.notes: therapist. Conducted therapy with Chet while wearing sunglasses, endured Chet's musical hijacking, charged $15,000 for the session.

characters.name: Chris
characters.notes: guest (parole officer). Joined for movie trailer segment, identified as a parole officer with own camera/mic, wore gold jacket, debated Minecraft movie merits.

storylines.beat: [2024-09-06] Case reveals week-long asset production for Candyland RPG stream scheduled Sunday 11 AM PT with sketch group Cigarette Sandwich and John Madison; Jelly Bean confirms seven video feeds planned.
[2024-09-06] Munch orders matching gold jackets for staff; Peter Gibbon admits intercepting first delivery; jackets noted as cheaply constructed and already collecting odor.

lore_notes.fact: Full name stated as 'Leonard Grumfuusius Grum'; denies grooming Sith apprentices.
Accidentally installed a 'Project Dr. Chath face on Pepito's face button' causing momentary human transformation during therapy transition.
Ordered gold jackets for staff; claims jacket makes him look 'fresh' despite cheap construction.
Admitted responsibility for first gold jacket shipment not arriving; operates board with paws.
Claims to bench 330 lbs (body weight) via single push-up out of bed; declares jawline a 'perfect union of masculinity.'
Wore sunglasses during therapy session; charged $15,000 for Hamilton-immersion therapy.
Appeared in pre-recorded Google Play promotional video with EDM artist Zed at a playground activation; Case urged chat to comment 'nice things' using name Kendall.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News returned from a week-long hiatus with matching gold jackets for staff, a Hype Train freestyle reaching level 5, and a news docket covering Hulk Hogan's podcast appearance, a $10M AI music streaming fraud indictment, and a DOJ allegation that Russia funded conservative influencers via Tenet Media. Munch and Crum debated JD Vance's humanity while the jackets collected odor, and the broadcast closed with a Hamilton-parody therapy session costing $15,000 before promoting Sunday's Candyland RPG event.
